equity.equity_measurement: Payor type (Medicare, Medicaid, commercial, self-pay/client, unspecified) is the only SES proxy; ages 0–19 excluded from Figure 2 for small numbers.

ev.q: By payor type, cured or cleared prevalences ranged from 23% for other to 45% for Medicare.
The prevalence of being cured or cleared was lowest among persons aged 20–29 years (24%), and highest among those aged ≥60 years (42%).
The highest proportion of cured or cleared among all age groups and payors was 49% for commercially insured persons aged ≥60 years.

notes: Figure 2 shows 95% CIs, but no conclusion rests on them, so no procedure is recorded; conditional proportions are arithmetic. The design is inferred as monitoring against the national ≥80% clearance goal.
